notes: Canonical expected values for every behavior shared by the python/, typescript/, rust/, and go/ implementations.
The four test suites assert these vectors. When a suite and this file disagree, this file wins: it is the contract the data partners consume.
Update this file in the same commit as any shared-behavior change.
